summary: Events, recurrence, alarms, ICS import/export and reminders exist inside the shell and the Calendar and Reminders apps. Apps with the calendars permission can read events in a date range through the calendar service (springboard/sdk/src/calendar.rs); there is no write API, no recurrence expansion and no access prompt yet.

features.note: Read side: the calendar service answers access (authorized when the manifest declares calendars, else denied) and events in a [start, end) range, with each repeating event expanded to its occurrences in the range, from the shared store (springboard/src/shell/calendar/store.rs, appdata/is.olibuijr.calendar.desktop/events.tsv); SDK calendar::access / events / decode_events. Built 2026-10-17: SDK calendar::update_event and delete_event (service methods update_event and delete_event, tests calendar::tests). Not yet: EKEventStore account writes, a permission prompt (the manifest is the grant), and Midget testing (host unit tests only)

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/calendar_store.rs (Event, Availability, Span, EventStore::save_event, EventStore::remove_event, EventStore::events_between); springboard/src/shell/calendar/store.rs (CalendarEvent); springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-43.rs
features.note: The event model has title, dates, the all-day flag, an identifier, a repeat interval in days, a URL and an availability; saving, removing with the ThisEvent and FutureEvents spans, the access gate, and the URL and availability round trip are verified headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs and parity_sdk-complete-43.rs. Gap: the shell store (location, notes, titles capped at 160 chars) is not wired to this model, and there are no structured attendees.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/reminders-desktop/src/model.rs; wired: springboard/apps/reminders-desktop/src/model.rs (tags_in, tag_counts, View::Tag); src/chrome.rs (Tags section in lists_source, sidebar_target); src/app.rs (Target::Tag); src/view.rs (list title), springboard/ui/src/calendar_store.rs (Reminder)
features.note: app-internal file store (store.rs); no SDK access Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity. Sprint 4: model with title, dueDateComponents, isCompleted, identifier, save/remove; not wired to the Reminders app, not run on Midget.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 4 tests. ICS import/export and colour plates; no account sources (CalDAV, Exchange) in the store model

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/conference.rs; wired: springboard/ui/src/calendar_participant.rs; springboard/apps/calendar-desktop/src/calendar/invitees.rs (editor row Target::Invitees in src/calendar.rs)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests. Wave 5 (theme-15, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no attendee or invitation model found Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/event_recurrence.rs (RecurrenceRule, RecurrenceEnd, RecurrenceDayOfWeek, EventStore::events_matching, Occurrence, Span); springboard/apps/calendar-desktop/src/calendar/recur.rs
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 29 tests. SDK pure model with host unit tests: RRULE FREQ, INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY (with week numbers), BYMONTHDAY (negative allowed), BYMONTH, BYSETPOS; events(matching:) expands occurrences with occurrenceDate, isDetached, excluded dates and EKSpan removal; floating times keep their wall-clock hour. Not yet wired into the shell calendar store (it keeps the 6 repeat choices, mapped by RecurrenceRule::from_repeat_choice) or the Calendar app, not yet tested on Midget; the app keeps its own recur.rs. reminders have own repeat.rs

Relative-offset alarms, their alert text, time zones, recurrence with exceptions and the rebuild rule are tested headless in springboard/apps/calendar-desktop/tests/parity_sdk-tests-07-w7.rs. Gap: no absolute or proximity alarms.
Weekday masks, the grace window and the next-occurrence rule are tested headless. Gap: no scheduler service or RTC wake exists yet, and Reminders and Calendar alerts have no schedule source.

gaps: No SDK reminder API for apps (calendar save, edit and delete are built: calendar::save_event, update_event, delete_event)
No calendar access prompt; the calendars manifest permission is the only grant
The calendar service returns base events; recurrence expansion is an SDK model (sdk event_recurrence.rs)
No attendees, invitations or account sources
